description: Telangana aims to lead India in digital agriculture using AI and IoT to boost small farmers’ income, says IT Minister Sridhar Babu.
body_lead: HYDERABAD: Telangana is gearing up to become a national leader in digital agriculture by leveraging emerging technologies for the benefit of small and marginal farmers, Minister for Information Technology and Industries Duddilla Sridhar Babu said on Tuesday.
